Alana: quick sync \u2014 we keep getting support tickets where dashboard badge says 'Overloaded' but SDKs see 429. customers confused.\nBen: agree. need a single source of truth for client-visible buckets + console labels.\nCarl: proposal: canonical buckets = rate_limit, capacity, transient. map codes: 429 -> rate_limit; 503+route-header -> capacity; 5xx (no route) -> transient.\nDina: also expose headers so SDKs can react: `x-rd-client-bucket`, `x-rd-route-reason`. example: `x-rd-client-bucket: capacity` and `x-rd-route-reason: capacity:fallback-quant`.\nAlana: console badge short labels: 'Throttled', 'Capacity', 'Transient'. hover text explains mapping and typical remediation.\nBen: SDK semantics: if bucket=capacity and downgrade-with-guarantee -> return 200 with `warnings` array. otherwise return 503 and body with `retry_after_seconds`.\nCarl: example response for SDKs:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-rd-client-bucket: capacity
x-rd-route-reason: capacity:fallback-to-quantized
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "request_id": "req_42",
  "error": {
    "code": "capacity_constrained",
    "message": "Routed to lower-tier model or rejected due to capacity"
  },
  "retry_after_seconds": 60
}
```\nDina: telemetry: increment `requests.total` and `requests.routed.capacity_fallback`. attach tags: tenant_id, route_tier, model_variant, region. store sampled payloads for runbook debugging.\nAlana: rollout UX: show a yellow inline banner on route page when capacity fallbacks > 1% over last 1h. banner includes sample curl + headers and a link to runbook.\nBen: runbook guardrails: auto-rollback if guard-set quality regression > 3% or capacity fallbacks > 5% for 1h. include prompt-set diffs and example queries.\nCarl: small note on naming: use `capacity` not `degraded` in all client-visible places to avoid ambiguity.\nDina: action items: I will add headers + counters; Ben will update SDK doc on 200-vs-503 downgrade behavior; Carl will add badge copy and hover text; Alana will write banner copy and link runbook; infra-bot: schedule staging deploy.\ninfra-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2024-09-10T03:00:00Z (simulated).
